Use the derived fmarch_key_admin URL only in an ephemeral operator shell; after successful redeploy and connection drain, retire the prior passwords and URLs.
Set a new key and marker atomically on both services, deploy both, verify authenticated source attribution, then retire the prior value.

families.rotation: Add the prior KEK to the historical read ring, deploy a new active KEK and KID, then use fmarch-event-key-admin to plan, fence, and migrate every stream-DEK and registered direct envelope. Run the distinct removal rehearsal with the old KID absent; remove the hosted historical secret, redeploy every replica, and prove exact-commit startup/readiness before finalizing the immutable retired tombstone. Keep the old key only in offline escrow until every backup that can contain old-KID ciphertext has expired or been rotation-rehearsed on restore.

families.rotation: Stage and deploy the new archive KEK and KID with the prior archive KEK retained for reads, prove old archive import and new archive export, then retire the prior KEK only after the declared archive-retention window.

families.custody: Railway API holds only the active key; a local SSH-tunnel, fresh-environment one-shot admin child receives active and stdin-delivered replacement material; old-key escrow is offline and outside the repository

receipt_contract.storage: access-controlled append-only release-evidence ledger outside repository, Railway variables, application database, and service logs

families.rotation: Follow docs/ops/profile-handle-index-rotation.md exactly. Use the local Railway SSH database tunnel and railway run API source only to construct the fixed fresh-environment admin child; deliver replacement material once on stdin and never create a replacement-key service variable. Plan before and after a confirmed two-replica scale-to-zero drain, including every out-of-band/profile legacy writer, then run reindex with --writers-drained --execute. While traffic remains zero, set only the API active key and KID with deploys suppressed, verify replacement-only material is absent, restore exactly two replicas, and require the captured deployment ID and commit to reach terminal success, startup/readiness, owner-profile read, and duplicate-handle rejection. Write and validate the immutable secret-free rotation receipt after redeploy. Immediately retire the prior key from all live service variables, retain it only in offline escrow for 30 days, then destroy it and append and validate the linked escrow-destruction receipt. Never flip the API secret first or retain derived tokens in canonical profile events.
Issue environment-local bucket credentials, update the API references and marker, deploy and prove object reads/writes, then revoke the prior credentials.

families.rotation: Provision and explicitly bootstrap a new dedicated authority, migrate only active wrapped keys plus every authenticated revocation, atomically update genesis/revision and both KIDs/keys, deploy and verify startup reconciliation/readiness, then revoke prior bucket credentials and retire prior client-side keys without ever restoring a deleted subject key.
